description: Golf booking skill instructed calendar event creation via Outlook / MS365 MCP. Neither supports event creation — Outlook AppleScript threw error -1701, MS365 MCP is read-only. Calendar event was not created on the correct calendar.
correction: Use iCal (Calendar.app) via osascript to create events on the 'Family' calendar. Skill updated to reflect this.
systemic_fix: Updated skills/golf-booking/SKILL.md Step 6 to use Calendar.app AppleScript targeting the 'Family' calendar. Removed references to Outlook and MS365 MCP for event creation.
